title.en: Tools, dies, fixtures, and other process equipment specially designed for “superplastic forming” / “diffusion bonding” of titanium, aluminum, and their alloys to manufacture any of the following:

summary.zh: 为制造以下任一物项而专门设计用于钛、铝及其合金“超塑成形”/“扩散连接”的工具、模具、夹具等工艺装备：
summary.en: Tools, dies, fixtures, and other process equipment specially designed for “superplastic forming” / “diffusion bonding” of titanium, aluminum, and their alloys to manufacture any of the following:

text.zh:
1B003 为制造以下任一物项而专门设计用于钛、铝及其合金“超塑成形”/“扩散连接”的工具、模具、夹具等工艺装备：
a．航空器结构件或航天器结构件；
b．航空发动机或航天发动机；
c．为航空器结构件或航天器结构件专门设计的部件；
d．为航空发动机或航天发动机专门设计的部件。
技术说明：
1．“超塑成形”是指利用超塑性金属材料在特定温度和应变速率条件下表现出的超高延伸率及不易断裂的超塑性，在模具型腔内将超塑性金属板料作为被成形坯料实现成形加工，以获得各种所需形状零件的成形工艺。
2．“扩散连接”是指相互接触的两个材料表面，在温度和压力的作用下相互靠近，局部发生塑性变形，原子间产生相互扩散，在界面接触处形成扩散层，从而实现可靠连接的成形工艺。
text.en: 1B003 Tools, dies, fixtures, and other process equipment specially designed for “superplastic forming” / “diffusion bonding” of titanium, aluminum, and their alloys to manufacture any of the following: a. Aircraft or spacecraft structural parts; b. Aircraft or spacecraft engines; c. Components specially designed for aircraft or spacecraft structural parts; d. Components specially designed for aircraft or spacecraft engines. Technical Notes: 1. “Superplastic forming” means a forming process that uses the exceptionally high elongation and resistance to fracture exhibited by superplastic metallic materials at specific temperatures and strain rates, forming superplastic metal sheet blanks within a die cavity to obtain parts of various desired shapes. 2. “Diffusion bonding” means a forming process in which two contacting material surfaces are brought closer together under temperature and pressure, undergo localized plastic deformation and atomic interdiffusion, and form a diffusion layer at the interface, thereby achieving a reliable bond.

title.zh: 生产复合材料部件的设备及相关部件、配件：
title.en: Equipment for producing composite components, and related components and accessories:

summary.zh: 生产复合材料部件的设备及相关部件、配件：
summary.en: Equipment for producing composite components, and related components and accessories:

text.zh:
1B101 生产复合材料部件的设备及相关部件、配件：
a．三坐标或多坐标联动和编程控制的纤维缠绕机及为其专门设计的计算机；
b．具有两个或两个以上坐标的“数控”和编程控制的铺带机；
c．纤维结构复合材料编织机的成套附件及其改装附件；
d．用于生产聚合纤维（例如：聚丙烯腈、粘胶和聚碳硅烷）的设备，包括在加热过程中对纤维施加张力的专门设备；
e．在加热的纤维基体上用于进行元素和化合物气相沉积的设备；
f．耐火陶瓷（例如：氧化铝）的湿法纺丝设备；
g．用于对纤维表面进行特殊处理的设备；
h．用于生产预浸件和预成型件的设备；
i．用于复合材料结构件、层压板材和制品的预成型件加压、固化、浇注、热压或粘接的注模、芯模、压模和工装夹具等。
text.en: 1B101 Equipment for producing composite components, and related components and accessories: a. Filament-winding machines with coordinated motion and programmed control in three or more axes, and computers specially designed therefor; b. Tape-laying machines with “numerical control” and programmed control in two or more axes; c. Complete sets of accessories and modification accessories for weaving machines for fibrous composite structures; d. Equipment for producing polymeric fibers (e.g., polyacrylonitrile, rayon, and polycarbosilane), including equipment specially designed to apply tension to fibers during heating; e. Equipment for vapor deposition of elements and compounds on heated fibrous substrates; f. Wet-spinning equipment for refractory ceramics (e.g., alumina); g. Equipment for special treatment of fiber surfaces; h. Equipment for producing prepregs and preforms; i. Molds, mandrels, dies, tooling, and fixtures for pressing, curing, casting, hot pressing, or bonding composite structural parts, laminates, and product preforms.

text.zh:
1B226 为一个或多个离子源设计或配备，能够提供总的离子束电流大于等于50 mA 的电磁同位素分离器。
说明：
1．1B226 项管制能够富集稳定同位素以及铀同位素的分离器。能够分离一个质量单位差的铅同位素的分离器，必然能够富集有三个质量单位差的铀同位素。
2．1B226 项管制离子源和收集器都在磁场内的分离器，以及两者都布置在磁场外的分离器。
技术说明：单一50 mA 离子源可以从天然丰度的给料中每年分离出不到3g 的高浓铀（HEU）。
text.en: 1B226 Electromagnetic isotope separators designed for, or equipped with, one or more ion sources capable of providing a total ion-beam current of 50 mA or greater. Notes: 1. 1B226 controls separators capable of enriching stable isotopes as well as uranium isotopes. A separator capable of separating lead isotopes differing by one mass unit is inherently capable of enriching uranium isotopes differing by three mass units. 2. 1B226 controls separators with both the ion source and collector within the magnetic field, and separators with both located outside the magnetic field. Technical Note: A single 50 mA ion source can separate less than 3 g of highly enriched uranium (HEU) per year from natural-abundance feed material.

summary.zh: 具有以下所有特性的氢-低温蒸馏塔：

text.zh:
1B228 具有以下所有特性的氢-低温蒸馏塔：
a．工作时的内部温度小于等于-238 ℃；
b．工作时的内部压力为0.5～5 MPa（5～50 个大气压）；
c．用以下任一材料制成：
1．用含硫量低并采用ASTM 标准（或等效国家标准）晶粒级别为5 级或5 级以上的国际汽车工程师协会奥氏体300 系列不锈钢制成；
2．耐低温并与氢（H₂）相容的等效材料；
d．内径大于等于30 cm，“有效长度”大于等于4 m。
技术说明：“有效长度”是指填料塔中填充材料的有效高度或板式塔中内接触板的有效高度。
text.en: 1B228 Hydrogen cryogenic distillation columns having all of the following characteristics: a. Internal operating temperatures of -238 °C or lower; b. Internal operating pressures of 0.5–5 MPa (5–50 atmospheres); c. Made of either of the following materials: 1. Low-sulfur SAE 300-series austenitic stainless steel with an ASTM (or equivalent national standard) grain-size number of 5 or higher; 2. Equivalent materials compatible with hydrogen (H₂) and cryogenic temperatures; d. An inside diameter of 30 cm or greater and an “effective length” of 4 m or greater. Technical Note: “Effective length” means the active height of packing material in a packed column or the active height of internal contactor plates in a plate column.

title.zh: 水-硫化氢交换板式塔及其内接触器：
title.en: Water–hydrogen sulfide exchange tray columns and internal contactors therefor:

summary.zh: 水-硫化氢交换板式塔及其内接触器：
summary.en: Water–hydrogen sulfide exchange tray columns and internal contactors therefor:

text.zh:
1B229 水-硫化氢交换板式塔及其内接触器：
注意：关于为生产重水而专门设计或配备的交换塔，按照《中华人民共和国核出口管制清单》加以管制。
a．具有以下所有特性的水-硫化氢交换板式塔：
1．标准工作压力能够大于等于2 MPa；
2．用采用ASTM 标准（或等效国家标准）晶粒级别为5 级或5 级以上的奥氏体细晶粒碳钢制成等效国家标准；
3．直径大于等于1.8 m；
b．1B229.a 项所管制的水-硫化氢交换板式塔的内接触器。
技术说明：塔的内接触器是各种扇形板，有效组装直径大于等于1.8 m，其设计有利于逆流接触，并用碳含量小于等于0.03％的耐硫化氢、水混合物腐蚀的不锈钢制成。这些接触器可为筛板、浮阀塔板、泡罩塔盘或栅板塔盘。
text.en: 1B229 Water–hydrogen sulfide exchange tray columns and internal contactors therefor: N.B.: Exchange columns specially designed or prepared for heavy-water production are controlled under the Nuclear Export Control List of the People's Republic of China. a. Water–hydrogen sulfide exchange tray columns having all of the following characteristics: 1. Capable of nominal operating pressures of 2 MPa or greater; 2. Made of fine-grain carbon steel with an austenitic ASTM (or equivalent national standard) grain-size number of 5 or higher; equivalent national standard [repeated in source]; 3. A diameter of 1.8 m or greater; b. Internal contactors for water–hydrogen sulfide exchange tray columns controlled under 1B229.a. Technical Note: Column internal contactors are segmented trays with an effective assembled diameter of 1.8 m or greater, designed to facilitate countercurrent contact and made of stainless steel with a carbon content of 0.03% or less that is resistant to corrosion by hydrogen sulfide/water mixtures. These contactors may be sieve trays, valve trays, bubble-cap trays, or turbogrid trays.

title.zh: 氚设施、工厂及其设备：
title.en: Tritium facilities, plants, and equipment therefor:

summary.zh: 氚设施、工厂及其设备：
summary.en: Tritium facilities, plants, and equipment therefor:

text.zh:
1B231 氚设施、工厂及其设备：
a．用于生产、回收、提取、浓缩或处理氚的设施或工厂；
b．氚设施或工厂用设备：
1．能够冷却到-250 ℃或更低温度，散热能力大于150 W 的氢或氦的制冷单元；
2．使用金属氢化物作为贮存或净化介质的氢同位素贮存系统和净化系统。
text.en: 1B231 Tritium facilities, plants, and equipment therefor: a. Facilities or plants for producing, recovering, extracting, concentrating, or handling tritium; b. Equipment for tritium facilities or plants: 1. Hydrogen or helium refrigeration units capable of cooling to -250 °C or lower, with a heat-removal capacity greater than 150 W; 2. Hydrogen-isotope storage and purification systems using metal hydrides as the storage or purification medium.

1B233 锂同位素分离设施、工厂、系统和设备：
注意：等离子体分离过程中的某些锂同位素分离设备和部件可直接用于铀浓缩分离的，按照《中华人民共和国核出口管制清单》加以管制。
a．锂同位素分离设施或工厂；
b．基于锂-汞齐工艺过程的锂同位素分离设备：
1．专门设计用于锂汞齐的液-液交换填料塔；
2．汞或锂汞齐泵；
3．锂汞齐电解槽；
4．用于浓缩氢氧化锂溶液的蒸发器；
c．为锂同位素分离专门设计的离子交换系统，以及为其专门设计的部件；
d．为锂同位素分离专门设计的化学交换系统（采用冠醚、穴醚和套索醚），以及为其专门设计的部件。
text.en: 1B233 Lithium-isotope separation facilities, plants, systems, and equipment: N.B.: Certain lithium-isotope separation equipment and components used in plasma separation that are directly usable for uranium enrichment and separation are controlled under the Nuclear Export Control List of the People's Republic of China. a. Lithium-isotope separation facilities or plants; b. Lithium-isotope separation equipment based on the lithium–mercury amalgam process: 1. Packed liquid–liquid exchange columns specially designed for lithium amalgams; 2. Mercury or lithium-amalgam pumps; 3. Lithium-amalgam electrolysis cells; 4. Evaporators for concentrating lithium-hydroxide solutions; c. Ion-exchange systems specially designed for lithium-isotope separation and specially designed components therefor; d. Chemical-exchange systems (using crown ethers, cryptands, and lariat ethers) specially designed for lithium-isotope separation and specially designed components therefor.

summary.zh: 石墨及其制品：
summary.en: Graphite and graphite products:

text.zh:
1C108 石墨及其制品：
a．在20 ℃温度下测得具有以下所有特性的人造细晶粒整体石墨：
1．密度大于1.72 g/cm³；
2．“拉伸断裂应变”大于等于0.7%；
3．“热膨胀系数”小于等于2.75×10⁻⁶/℃；
b．具有以下所有特性的人造石墨材料及其制品：
1．纯度大于99.9%；
2．抗折强度大于30 Mpa；
3．密度大于1.73 g/cm³；
c．天然鳞片石墨及其制品（包含球化石墨、膨胀石墨等）。
text.en: 1C108 Graphite and graphite products: a. Artificial fine-grained bulk graphite having all of the following characteristics measured at 20 °C: 1. A density greater than 1.72 g/cm³; 2. A “tensile strain at fracture” of 0.7% or greater; 3. A “coefficient of thermal expansion” of 2.75×10⁻⁶/°C or less; b. Artificial graphite materials and products having all of the following characteristics: 1. A purity greater than 99.9%; 2. A flexural strength greater than 30 MPa; 3. A density greater than 1.73 g/cm³; c. Natural flake graphite and products thereof (including spheroidized graphite, expanded graphite, etc.).

title.zh: 推进剂：
title.en: Propellants:

summary.zh: 推进剂：
summary.en: Propellants:

text.zh:
1C111 推进剂：
a．液体推进剂：
1．纯度70%以上的肼；
2．偏二甲肼；
3．甲基肼；
4．混胺；
5．四氧化二氮；
6．红发烟硝酸；
b．固体推进剂及其组分：
1．由尺寸小于500 μm，不论球形、椭球体、雾化、片状或研碎的颗粒组成，且含以下任何金属或其合金大于等于97%（按重量计）的金属粉末：
a．锆；
b．硼；
c．镁；
d．钛；
e．铀；
f．钨；
g．锌；
h．铈；
2．颗粒小于500 μm 的球形高氯酸铵（过氯酸铵）；
3．具有以下所有特性的球形铝粉：
a．颗粒均匀；
b．铝含量大于等于97%（按重量计）；
c．颗粒小于500 μm；
4．能量密度大于40×10⁶ J/kg 的硼浆；
5．硝胺类：
a．奥托金（环四甲基四硝胺HMX）；
b．黑索金（环三甲基三硝胺RDX）；
6．复合推进剂：
a．模压的胶质推进剂；
b．含有硝化粘接剂和5%以上的铝粉的推进剂；
7．聚合物：
a．端羧基聚丁二烯（CTPB）；
text.en: 1C111 Propellants: a. Liquid propellants: 1. Hydrazine with a purity of 70% or greater; 2. Unsymmetrical dimethylhydrazine; 3. Monomethylhydrazine; 4. Mixed amines; 5. Dinitrogen tetroxide; 6. Red fuming nitric acid; b. Solid propellants and their constituents: 1. Metal powders consisting of particles smaller than 500 μm, whether spherical, spheroidal, atomized, flaked, or ground, containing 97% or more by weight of any of the following metals or their alloys: a. Zirconium; b. Boron; c. Magnesium; d. Titanium; e. Uranium; f. Tungsten; g. Zinc; h. Cerium; 2. Spherical ammonium perchlorate with a particle size smaller than 500 μm; 3. Spherical aluminum powder having all of the following characteristics: a. Uniform particles; b. An aluminum content of 97% or greater by weight; c. A particle size smaller than 500 μm; 4. Boron slurry with an energy density greater than 40×10⁶ J/kg; 5. Nitramines: a. Octogen (cyclotetramethylenetetranitramine, HMX); b. Hexogen (cyclotrimethylenetrinitramine, RDX); 6. Composite propellants: a. Molded colloidal propellants; b. Propellants containing nitrated binders and 5% or more aluminum powder; 7. Polymers: a. Carboxyl-terminated polybutadiene (CTPB);

text.zh:
b．端羟基聚丁二烯（HTPB）；
8．三乙胺点火剂。
text.en: b. Hydroxyl-terminated polybutadiene (HTPB); 8. Triethylamine ignition agents.

text.zh:
1C118 具有以下所有特性的钛稳定双相不锈钢：
a．铬含量17%～26.5%（按重量计）且镍含量4.5%～7%（按重量计）；
b．铁素体-奥氏体微观结构（也称“双相”微观结构），其中奥氏体的体积百分比大于等于10%；
c．具有以下任一形状：
1．每一维的尺寸大于等于100 mm 的锭材或棒材；
2．宽度大于等于600 mm 且厚度小于等于3 mm 的薄板；
3．外径大于等于600 mm 且壁厚小于等于3 mm 的管材。
text.en: 1C118 Titanium-stabilized duplex stainless steel having all of the following characteristics: a. A chromium content of 17%–26.5% by weight and a nickel content of 4.5%–7% by weight; b. A ferritic–austenitic microstructure (also called a “duplex” microstructure), with an austenite content of 10% or greater by volume; c. In any of the following forms: 1. Ingots or bars with each dimension 100 mm or greater; 2. Sheets with a width of 600 mm or greater and a thickness of 3 mm or less; 3. Tubes with an outside diameter of 600 mm or greater and a wall thickness of 3 mm or less.

title.zh: 铝合金和钛合金：
title.en: Aluminum alloys and titanium alloys:

summary.zh: 铝合金和钛合金：
summary.en: Aluminum alloys and titanium alloys:

text.zh:
1C202 铝合金和钛合金：
a．具有以下两种特性的铝合金：
1．极限抗拉强度能够在20 ℃下达到460 MPa 或更高；
2．外径大于75 mm 的管材或圆柱形实心棒材（包括锻件）；
b．具有以下两种特性的钛合金：
1．极限抗拉强度能够在20 ℃下达到900 MPa 或更高；
2．外径大于75 mm 的管材或圆柱形实心棒材（包括锻件）。
技术说明：1C202 项所述的“能够”既指热处理前，也指热处理后能够达到特定指标的合金。
text.en: 1C202 Aluminum alloys and titanium alloys: a. Aluminum alloys having both of the following characteristics: 1. Capable of an ultimate tensile strength of 460 MPa or greater at 20 °C; 2. In the form of tubes or cylindrical solid bars (including forgings) with an outside diameter greater than 75 mm; b. Titanium alloys having both of the following characteristics: 1. Capable of an ultimate tensile strength of 900 MPa or greater at 20 °C; 2. In the form of tubes or cylindrical solid bars (including forgings) with an outside diameter greater than 75 mm. Technical Note: “Capable of” in 1C202 covers alloys that can achieve the specified properties either before or after heat treatment.

title.zh: 镍粉和多孔镍金属：
title.en: Nickel powder and porous nickel metal:

summary.zh: 镍粉和多孔镍金属：
summary.en: Nickel powder and porous nickel metal:

text.zh:
1C240 镍粉和多孔镍金属：
注意：专门为制造气体扩散膜而制备的镍粉，按照《中华人民共和国核出口管制清单》加以管制。
a．具有以下两种特性的镍粉：
1．镍纯度大于等于99%（按重量计）；
2．平均颗粒尺寸按ASTM B330 标准或等效国家标准测量小于10 µm；
b．由1C240.a 项所管制的材料生产的多孔镍金属。
说明：1C240 项不管制以下材料：
1．细丝状镍粉；
2．单块面积小于等于1000 cm² 的单张多孔镍金属板。
技术说明：1C240.b 项是指通过压制和烧结1C240.a 项所管制材料，形成整个结构内具有许多相连细孔的金属。
text.en: 1C240 Nickel powder and porous nickel metal: N.B.: Nickel powder specially prepared for manufacturing gaseous-diffusion barriers is controlled under the Nuclear Export Control List of the People's Republic of China. a. Nickel powder having both of the following characteristics: 1. A nickel purity of 99% or greater by weight; 2. An average particle size smaller than 10 µm, measured in accordance with ASTM B330 or an equivalent national standard; b. Porous nickel metal produced from materials controlled under 1C240.a. Note: 1C240 does not control the following materials: 1. Filamentary nickel powder; 2. Single sheets of porous nickel metal with an area of 1000 cm² or less per sheet. Technical Note: 1C240.b refers to metal formed by compacting and sintering materials controlled under 1C240.a, with numerous interconnected fine pores throughout its structure.

text.en: The “toxins” controlled under this item exclude toxins for immunization and pharmaceutical products for human or animal use approved by the competent national authorities. 3. 1C351 also controls human and zoonotic “pathogenic microorganisms” and animal “pathogenic microorganisms” newly discovered in China or exhibiting significant changes in biological characteristics that can cause serious harm to human or animal health.

title.zh: 遗传物质和遗传修饰生物体：
title.en: Genetic material and genetically modified organisms:

summary.zh: 遗传物质和遗传修饰生物体：
summary.en: Genetic material and genetically modified organisms:

text.zh:
1C353 遗传物质和遗传修饰生物体：
a．含有与本清单所管制微生物的致病性相关的核酸序列的遗传物质；
b．含有编码本清单所管制毒素及其亚单位核酸序列的遗传物质；
c．含有与清单所管制微生物的致病性相关的核酸序列的遗传修饰生物体；
d．含有编码本清单所管制毒素及其亚单位核酸序列的遗传修饰生物体。
技术说明：
1．遗传物质包括染色体、基因组、质粒、转座子、载体（无论是否经过遗传修饰）。
2．与本清单所管制微生物致病性相关的核酸序列是指与清单所管制微生物有关的以下特殊序列：
a．该序列本身或通过其转录或翻译产物会给人、动植物健康带来明显危害；
b．通过插入、替换、整合或缺失，该序列能增强清单所管制微生物或其他任何生物体对人、动植物健康造成严重损害的能力。
3．与肠出血性大肠埃希氏菌（О157 血清型）和其它产志贺样毒素菌株致病性相关的核酸序列不受管制，编码志贺样毒素或其亚单位的核酸序列则受管制。
text.en: 1C353 Genetic material and genetically modified organisms: a. Genetic material containing nucleic-acid sequences associated with the pathogenicity of microorganisms controlled by this list; b. Genetic material containing nucleic-acid sequences encoding toxins or their subunits controlled by this list; c. Genetically modified organisms containing nucleic-acid sequences associated with the pathogenicity of microorganisms controlled by this list; d. Genetically modified organisms containing nucleic-acid sequences encoding toxins or their subunits controlled by this list. Technical Notes: 1. Genetic material includes chromosomes, genomes, plasmids, transposons, and vectors, whether or not genetically modified. 2. Nucleic-acid sequences associated with the pathogenicity of microorganisms controlled by this list mean the following specific sequences associated with listed microorganisms: a. Sequences that, by themselves or through their transcription or translation products, pose a significant hazard to human, animal, or plant health; b. Sequences that, through insertion, substitution, integration, or deletion, enhance the ability of listed microorganisms or any other organism to cause serious harm to human, animal, or plant health. 3. Nucleic-acid sequences associated with the pathogenicity of enterohemorrhagic Escherichia coli (serotype O157) and other Shiga-like-toxin-producing strains are not controlled; nucleic-acid sequences encoding Shiga-like toxins or their subunits are controlled.

title.zh: 超高分子量聚乙烯纤维及其制品：
title.en: Ultrahigh-molecular-weight polyethylene fibers and products thereof:

summary.zh: 超高分子量聚乙烯纤维及其制品：
summary.en: Ultrahigh-molecular-weight polyethylene fibers and products thereof:

text.zh:
1C901 超高分子量聚乙烯纤维及其制品：
a．具有以下所有特性的超高分子量聚乙烯纤维：
1．断裂强度大于等于40cN/dtex；
2．初始模量大于等于1600cN/dtex；
3．未加捻；
b．由超高分子量聚乙烯纤维制成的软质无纬布叠层（不经加压）在面密度小于等于5.3kg/m² 的情况下，防1.1g 标准模拟破片（17 格令模拟破片FSP）V50 大于等于700m/s（按照GJB4300A-2012 附录B《弹道极限V50 试验方法》测试）。
text.en: 1C901 Ultrahigh-molecular-weight polyethylene fibers and products thereof: a. Ultrahigh-molecular-weight polyethylene fibers having all of the following characteristics: 1. A breaking tenacity of 40 cN/dtex or greater; 2. An initial modulus of 1600 cN/dtex or greater; 3. Untwisted; b. Soft unidirectional fabric laminates (without pressure consolidation) made from ultrahigh-molecular-weight polyethylene fibers, having an areal density of 5.3 kg/m² or less and a V50 of 700 m/s or greater against a 1.1 g standard fragment-simulating projectile (17-grain FSP), tested in accordance with Appendix B, “Ballistic Limit V50 Test Method,” of GJB 4300A-2012.

text.zh:
1C902 钐相关物项：
a．金属钐、含钐的合金及相关制品：
1．金属钐；
2．含钐的合金：
a．钐钴合金；
b．钐铁合金；
c．钐镍合金；
d．钐铝合金；
e．钐镁合金；
3．含钐的靶材：
a．钐靶；
b．钐钴合金靶；
c．钐铁合金靶；
4．钐钴永磁材料；
b．氧化钐及其混合物；
c．含钐的化合物及其混合物。
说明：
1．1C902.a.2 项所管制的合金包括锭、块、条、丝、片、棒、板、管、颗粒、粉末等形态。
2．1C902.a.3 项所管制的靶材包括片、管等形态。
3．1C902.a.4 项所管制的永磁材料包括磁体或磁粉。
4．1C902.b、1C902.c 项所管制的氧化物、化合物及其混合物包括但不限于粉末等形态。
text.en: 1C902 Samarium-related items: a. Samarium metal, samarium-containing alloys, and related products: 1. Samarium metal; 2. Samarium-containing alloys: a. Samarium–cobalt alloys; b. Samarium–iron alloys; c. Samarium–nickel alloys; d. Samarium–aluminum alloys; e. Samarium–magnesium alloys; 3. Samarium-containing targets: a. Samarium targets; b. Samarium–cobalt alloy targets; c. summary.zh: 用耐液态锕系元素金属的材料制造的坩埚：
summary.en: Crucibles made of materials resistant to liquid actinide metals:

text.zh:
2A225 用耐液态锕系元素金属的材料制造的坩埚：
a．具有以下两种特性的坩埚：
1．容积150～8000 cm³ 或150～8000 ml；
2．用总不纯度小于等于2%（按重量计）的以下任何一种材料或以下材料组合制造的或作涂层：
a．氟化钙（CaF₂）；
b．锆酸钙（偏锆酸盐）（CaZrO₃）；
c．硫化铈（Ce₂S₃）；
d．氧化铒（Er₂O₃）；
e．氧化铪（HfO₂）；
f．氧化镁（MgO）；
g．氮化铌-钛-钨合金（约50%铌、30%钛和20%钨）；
h．氧化钇（Y₂O₃）；
i．氧化锆（ZrO₂）；
b．具有以下两种特性的坩埚：
1．容积50～2000 cm³ 或50～2000 ml；
2．用纯度大于等于99.9%（按重量计）的钽制造或作衬里；
c．具有以下所有特性的坩埚：
1．容积50～2000 cm³ 或50～2000 ml；
2．用纯度大于等于98%（按重量计）的钽制造或作衬里；
text.en: 2A225 Crucibles made of materials resistant to liquid actinide metals: a. Crucibles having both of the following characteristics: 1. A volume of 150–8000 cm³ or 150–8000 ml; 2. Made of or coated with any of the following materials, or combinations thereof, with a total impurity content of 2% or less by weight: a. Calcium fluoride (CaF₂); b. Calcium zirconate (metazirconate) (CaZrO₃); c. Cerium sulfide (Ce₂S₃); d. Erbium oxide (Er₂O₃); e. Hafnium oxide (HfO₂); f. Magnesium oxide (MgO); g. Nitrided niobium–titanium–tungsten alloy (approximately 50% niobium, 30% titanium, and 20% tungsten); h. Yttrium oxide (Y₂O₃); i. Zirconium oxide (ZrO₂); b. Crucibles having both of the following characteristics: 1. A volume of 50–2000 cm³ or 50–2000 ml; 2. Made of or lined with tantalum of 99.9% purity or greater by weight; c. Crucibles having all of the following characteristics: 1. A volume of 50–2000 cm³ or 50–2000 ml; 2. Made of or lined with tantalum of 98% purity or greater by weight;

text.zh: 3．用碳化钽、氮化钽、硼化钽或上述材料的任何组合作涂层。
text.en: 3. Coated with tantalum carbide, tantalum nitride, tantalum boride, or any combination of these materials.

summary.zh: 用于切削或切割金属、陶瓷或复合材料且根据制造商的技术说明书，可以配备沿2 个或多个轴同时进行“成形控制”的电子装置的机床及其任何组合：
summary.en: Machine tools, and any combination thereof, for removing or cutting metals, ceramics, or composites that, according to the manufacturer's technical specifications, can be equipped with electronic devices for simultaneous “contouring control” in two or more axes:

text.zh:
2B201 用于切削或切割金属、陶瓷或复合材料且根据制造商的技术说明书，可以配备沿2 个或多个轴同时进行“成形控制”的电子装置的机床及其任何组合：
注意：由2B201 项附属软件控制的“数控”单元，见2D203 项。
a．具有以下两种特性的车床：
1．能够加工件直径大于35 mm 的车床；
2．按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准，“定位精度”在采取了所有补偿手段后沿任一直线坐标可达到小于6 µm（总“定位精度”）；
说明：2B201.a 项不管制仅加工贯穿进给的棒料，棒料最大直径小于等于42 mm，并且无法安装卡盘能力的棒料车床。车床可对直径小于42 mm 的加工零件进行钻、铣加工。
b．具有以下任一特性的铣床：
1．按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准，“定位精度”在采取了所有补偿手段后沿任一直线坐标可达到小于6 µm（总“定位精度”）；
2．有2 个或多个成形旋转轴；
text.en: 2B201 Machine tools, and any combination thereof, for removing or cutting metals, ceramics, or composites that, according to the manufacturer's technical specifications, can be equipped with electronic devices for simultaneous “contouring control” in two or more axes: N.B.: For “numerical control” units controlled by software associated with 2B201, see 2D203. a. Turning machines having both of the following characteristics: 1. Capable of machining workpieces with diameters greater than 35 mm; 2. “Positioning accuracy,” with all compensations available, of less than 6 µm along any linear axis (overall “positioning accuracy”), according to ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; Note: 2B201.a does not control bar machines limited to machining through-feed bar stock with a maximum diameter of 42 mm or less and incapable of being fitted with a chuck. These machines may have drilling and milling capabilities for workpieces with diameters smaller than 42 mm. b. Milling machines having any of the following characteristics: 1. “Positioning accuracy,” with all compensations available, of less than 6 µm along any linear axis (overall “positioning accuracy”), according to ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; 2. Two or more contouring rotary axes;

text.zh:
3．具有可以同时协调进行“成形控制”的5 个或更多的轴；
说明：2B201.b 项不管制具有以下两种特性的铣床：
1．X 轴行程大于2 m；
2．按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准，沿X 轴的总“定位精度”大于30 µm。
c．具有以下任一特性的磨床：
1．按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准，“定位精度”在采取了所有补偿手段后沿任一直线坐标可达到小于4 µm（总“定位精度”）；
2．有2 个或多个成形旋转轴；
3．具有可以同时协调进行“成形控制”的5 个或更多的轴；
说明：2B201.c 项不管制以下磨床：
1．具有以下所有特性的外圆、内圆和内-外圆磨床：
a．限于加工最大外径或长度为150 mm 的工件；
b．限于x、z 和c 轴；
2．没有按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准总“定位精度”小于（优于）4 µm 的z 轴或w 轴的坐标磨。
d．具有2
text.en: 3. Five or more axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control”; Note: 2B201.b does not control milling machines having both of the following characteristics: 1. X-axis travel greater than 2 m; 2. Overall “positioning accuracy” along the X-axis greater than 30 µm, according to ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard. c. Grinding machines having any of the following characteristics: 1. “Positioning accuracy,” with all compensations available, of less than 4 µm along any linear axis (overall “positioning accuracy”), according to ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; 2. Two or more contouring rotary axes; 3. Five or more axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control”; Note: 2B201.c does not control the following grinding machines: 1. External, internal, and external/internal cylindrical grinding machines having all of the following characteristics: a. Limited to machining workpieces with a maximum outside diameter or length of 150 mm; b. Limited to x, z, and c axes; 2. Jig grinders without a z-axis or w-axis having an overall “positioning accuracy” of less than (better than) 4 µm according to ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard. d. Non-wire electrical-discharge machines (EDM) having two

text.zh:
个或更多个成形旋转轴并能同时协调进行“成形控制”的无线型放电加工机（EDM）。
说明：
1．按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准进行测量后，根据以下“程序”得出声称的“定位精度”水平，如果提供给国家有关主管部门并得到认可，可以用于每种型号机床的测试以代替对单个机床的测试。按照以下“程序”得出声称的“定位精度”：
a．选择某一型号5 台机器以供评价；
b．按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准，测量直线坐标“精度”；
c．测量每台机器每一轴线的精度值（A）。ISO230-2:1988 标准或等效国家标准中介绍了计算精度值的方法；
d．测量每一轴线的平均精度值。此平均值即可成为该型号机器每一轴线声称的“定位精度”（Âx，Ây……）；
e．既然2B201 项提到每个直线坐标，因此将会得出与线性轴数同样多的声称的“定位精度”值；
f．如果不受2B201.a、2B201.b 或2B201.c
text.en: or more contouring rotary axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control.” Notes: 1. Claimed “positioning accuracy” levels derived using the following “procedure,” after measurement according to ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard, may be used for testing each machine-tool model instead of individual machines if submitted to and accepted by the competent national authorities. Derive the claimed “positioning accuracy” using the following “procedure”: a. Select five machines of a particular model for evaluation; b. Measure linear-axis “accuracy” according to ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; c. Determine the accuracy value (A) for each axis of each machine. ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard describes the method for calculating the accuracy value; d. Determine the average accuracy value for each axis. This average becomes the claimed “positioning accuracy” for each axis of that machine model (Âx, Ây, etc.); e. Because 2B201 refers to each linear axis, the number of claimed “positioning accuracy” values will equal the number of linear axes; f. For a machine tool not controlled under 2B201.a, 2B201.b, or 2B201.c,

text.zh:
项管制的某一机床的任何轴线声称“定位精度”，对磨床而言小于等于6 µm 和对铣床和车床而言为小于等于8 µm（两者均按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准测定），则应要求制造商每18 个月重新确定一次精度水平。
2．2B201 项不管制限于加工以下部件的专用机床:
a．齿轮；
b．曲轴或凸轮轴；
c．工具或刀具；
d．挤压机螺杆。
技术说明：
1．轴应根据国际标准（ISO841《数控机床——轴和动作的名称》）或等效国家标准命名。
2．二次平行轴的数量成形未计入成形轴的总数量。（例如：在水平镗床上的w 轴或中心线与一次转轴平行的二次转轴）。
3．旋转轴不一定需要旋转360 度。旋转轴可由丝杆或齿轮-齿条之类线性机构驱动。
4．就2B201 项而言，可同时协调的“成形控制”的轴数是指在加工中沿这些轴或围绕这些轴可实现工件与刀具间同时且有关联的运动的轴数。这不包括任何其他的轴，沿这些轴或围绕这些轴在车床上实现其他有关运动，
text.en: if the claimed “positioning accuracy” of any axis is 6 µm or less for grinding machines, or 8 µm or less for milling and turning machines (both determined according to ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard), the manufacturer shall be required to reestablish the accuracy level every 18 months. 2. 2B201 does not control special-purpose machine tools limited to manufacturing the following parts: a. Gears; b. Crankshafts or camshafts; c. Tools or cutters; d. Extruder screws. Technical Notes: 1. Axes shall be named according to the international standard ISO 841, “Numerically controlled machines—Nomenclature of axes and motions,” or an equivalent national standard. 2. Secondary parallel contouring axes are not counted in the total number of contouring axes. Examples include the w-axis on horizontal boring mills or a secondary rotary axis whose centerline is parallel to the primary rotary axis. 3. Rotary axes need not rotate through 360 degrees. A rotary axis may be driven by a linear device, such as a screw or rack and pinion. 4. For 2B201, the number of axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control” is the number along or about which simultaneous, interrelated motion between the workpiece and tool can occur during machining. This excludes any other axes along or about which other related movements are performed on the machine tool,

text.zh:
例如：
a．磨床的轮装置系统；
b．用来装卸其他工件的平行旋转轴；
c．用来从不同端点将同一工件装入卡盘的共线旋转轴；
5．具有车、铣、磨3 个功能中2 个或2 个以上功能（如车床具有铣的功能）的工具，要分别以2B201.a、2B201.b 和2B201.c 项加以评估。
6．2B201.b.3、2B201.c.3 项管制基于平行线性动力学设计，具有5 个或更多非旋转轴的机床（例如：并联机床）。
text.en: for example: a. Wheel-dressing systems in grinding machines; b. Parallel rotary axes for loading or unloading other workpieces; c. Collinear rotary axes for holding the same workpiece in a chuck from different ends; 5. Machine tools having two or more of the three capabilities of turning, milling, and grinding (e.g., a turning machine with milling capability) shall be evaluated separately under 2B201.a, 2B201.b, and 2B201.c. 6. 2B201.b.3 and 2B201.c.3 control machine tools based on parallel linear kinematic designs with five or more nonrotary axes (e.g., parallel-kinematic machine tools).

title.zh: 尺寸检验仪、装置或系统：
title.en: Dimensional inspection instruments, devices, or systems:

summary.zh: 尺寸检验仪、装置或系统：
summary.en: Dimensional inspection instruments, devices, or systems:

text.zh:
2B206 尺寸检验仪、装置或系统：
a．具有以下任一特性的计算机控制或“数控”坐标测量仪：
1．有2 个轴，并且根据ISO 10360-2（2009）或等效国家标准，在坐标测量仪运行范围内（即在轴的长度范围内）的任何点，沿任一轴（一维）的长度测量的最大允许误差（以E0x MPE、E0y MPE 或E0z MPE的任何组合表示）小于等于（1.25+L/1000）µm（L 是所测长度，单位：mm）；
2．有3 个或更多个轴，并且根据ISO 10360-2（2009）或等效国家标准，在坐标测量仪运行范围内（即在轴的长度范围内）的任何点，长度测量的三维（体积）最大允许误差（E0, MPE）小于等于（1.7+L/800）µm（L 是所测长度，单位：mm）；
技术说明：制造商根据ISO 10360-2（2009）或等效国家标准具体规定的坐标测量仪最精确装置（例如：探头、触针长度、运动参数、环境中最佳部分）的E₀ ，MPE
text.en: 2B206 Dimensional inspection instruments, devices, or systems: a. Computer-controlled or “numerically controlled” coordinate measuring machines having either of the following characteristics: 1. Two axes and, at any point within the operating range (i.e., along the length of the axes), a maximum permissible error of length measurement along any one axis (one-dimensional), expressed as any combination of E0x MPE, E0y MPE, or E0z MPE, of (1.25+L/1000) µm or less, according to ISO 10360-2 (2009) or an equivalent national standard (L is the measured length in mm); 2. Three or more axes and, at any point within the operating range (i.e., along the length of the axes), a three-dimensional (volumetric) maximum permissible error of length measurement (E0, MPE) of (1.7+L/800) µm or less, according to ISO 10360-2 (2009) or an equivalent national standard (L is the measured length in mm); Technical Note: The E₀,MPE of the most accurate configuration of the coordinate measuring machine specified by the manufacturer according to ISO 10360-2 (2009) or an equivalent national standard (e.g., probe, stylus length, motion parameters, and optimum environmental conditions),

text.zh:
在采取一切可利用的补偿后应与1.7+L/800µm 的阀值可比。
b．“线性位移”测量仪：
1．测量范围不超过0.2 mm 时，“分辨率”小于等于0.2 µm的非接触型测量系统；
2．具有以下两种特性的线性可变差动变压器系统（LVDT）：
a．具有以下任一特性：
1．对于运行范围不超过5 mm 的线性可变差动变压器，从0 到全运行范围内测得的“线性度”小于等于0.1%；
2．对于运行范围超过5 mm 的线性可变差动变压器，从0到5 mm 范围测得的“线性度”小于等于0.1%；
b．在标准环境试验室，其温度变化为±1 ºC 时，每天漂移量小于等于0.1%；
3．具有以下两种特性的测量系统：
a．装有“激光器”；
b．在温度变化范围为±1 ºC 的标准温度和标准压力下，能够保持以下两种特性至少12 h：
1．满量程的“分辨率”大于等于0.1 µm；
2．“测量不确定度”小于等于（0.2+L/2000）µm（L 是所测长度，
text.en: after all available compensation, shall be compared with the threshold of 1.7+L/800 µm. b. “Linear displacement” measuring instruments: 1. Noncontact measuring systems with a “resolution” of 0.2 µm or less over a measuring range not exceeding 0.2 mm; 2. Linear variable differential transformer (LVDT) systems having both of the following characteristics: a. Either of the following characteristics: 1. For LVDTs with an operating range not exceeding 5 mm, “linearity” of 0.1% or less measured from zero to the full operating range; 2. For LVDTs with an operating range exceeding 5 mm, “linearity” of 0.1% or less measured from zero to 5 mm; b. Drift of 0.1% or less per day in a standard environmental test room with temperature variations of ±1 °C; 3. Measuring systems having both of the following characteristics: a. Equipped with a “laser”; b. Capable of maintaining both of the following characteristics for at least 12 h at standard temperature and pressure, with temperature variations of ±1 °C: 1. Full-scale “resolution” of 0.1 µm or greater [operator retained from source]; 2. “Measurement uncertainty” of (0.2+L/2000) µm or less (L is the measured length,

text.zh:
单位：mm）；
说明：2B206.b.3 项不管制测量用干涉仪系统，该系统无闭环或开环反馈，装有“激光器”用于测量机床、尺寸检验仪或相似设备的滑座运动误差。
技术说明：在2B206.b 项中，“线性位移”是指测量探头与被测物体之间距离的变化。
c．“角位偏差”小于等于0.00025°的角位移测量仪；
说明：2B206.c 项不管制光学仪器，如使用准直光（例如：激光）检测镜子角位移的自动准直仪。
d．具有以下两种特性，用于同时检查半壳件线-角位移的系统：
1．沿任一直线坐标轴的“测量不确定度”，每5 mm 小于等于3.5 µm；
2．“角位偏差”小于等于0.02°。
说明：
1．除2B201 项所管制的机床外，如果可用于测量的机床，其性能达到或超过2B206 项规定的标准，则受2B206 项管制。
2．如果2B206 项所述的尺寸检验仪在其运行范围内的任何方面超过规定的阈值，则这种检验仪应加以管制。
text.en: in mm); Note: 2B206.b.3 does not control measuring interferometer systems without closed-loop or open-loop feedback that contain a “laser” to measure slide-motion errors of machine tools, dimensional inspection instruments, or similar equipment. Technical Note: In 2B206.b, “linear displacement” means the change in distance between the measuring probe and the object being measured. c. Angular displacement measuring instruments with an “angular position deviation” of 0.00025° or less; Note: 2B206.c does not control optical instruments, such as autocollimators, using collimated light (e.g., laser light) to detect the angular displacement of a mirror. d. Systems for simultaneous linear and angular inspection of hemishells, having both of the following characteristics: 1. “Measurement uncertainty” along any linear axis of 3.5 µm or less per 5 mm; 2. “Angular position deviation” of 0.02° or less. Notes: 1. Machine tools usable for measuring, other than those controlled under 2B201, are controlled under 2B206 if their performance meets or exceeds the criteria specified in 2B206. 2. Dimensional inspection instruments described in 2B206 are controlled if they exceed a specified threshold anywhere within their operating range.

text.zh: 技术说明：本项的测量值的所有参数均有正负之分，即不表示正负区间的整个范围。
text.en: Technical Note: All measurement parameters in this item are expressed as plus/minus values, rather than the full span from negative to positive.

title.zh: “机器人”“末端操纵装置”和控制器：
title.en: “Robots,” “end-effectors,” and controllers:

summary.zh: “机器人”“末端操纵装置”和控制器：
summary.en: “Robots,” “end-effectors,” and controllers:

text.zh:
2B207 “机器人”“末端操纵装置”和控制器：
a．具有以下任一特性的“机器人”或“末端操纵装置”：
1．按照国家安全标准专门设计，能用于处理高能炸药（例如：符合高能炸药电气法规标称值）；
2．专门设计或评定为抗辐射的，能经受大于5×10⁴ Gy（硅）的辐射而不会降低使用性能；
技术说明：Gy（硅）是指某一未屏蔽的硅样品暴露于电离辐射时所吸收的能量，以J/kg 为单位。
b．为2B207.a 项所管制的任何“机器人”或“末端操纵装置”专门设计的控制器。
说明：2B207 项不管制为诸如汽车喷漆台之类的非核工业应用而专门设计的“机器人”。
技术说明：
1．在2B207 项中，“机器人”是指一种操纵机构，可以连续轨径作业或按点位作业，还可能使用“传感器”并具有以下所有特性：
a．多功能；
b．通过在三维空间中的可变移动能够使材料、零件、工具或专用装置定位或定向；
c．包含3 个或更多个可能装有步进电机的闭环或开环伺服装置；
text.en: 2B207 “Robots,” “end-effectors,” and controllers: a. “Robots” or “end-effectors” having either of the following characteristics: 1. Specially designed to comply with national safety standards for handling high explosives (e.g., meeting electrical-code ratings for high explosives); 2. Specially designed or rated as radiation-hardened to withstand more than 5×10⁴ Gy (silicon) without degradation of operational performance; Technical Note: Gy (silicon) means the energy absorbed by an unshielded silicon sample exposed to ionizing radiation, expressed in J/kg. b. Controllers specially designed for any “robots” or “end-effectors” controlled under 2B207.a. Note: 2B207 does not control “robots” specially designed for nonnuclear industrial applications, such as automotive paint booths. Technical Notes: 1. In 2B207, a “robot” means a manipulation mechanism that may operate along a continuous path or point-to-point, may use “sensors,” and has all of the following characteristics: a. Multifunctional; b. Capable of positioning or orienting materials, parts, tools, or special devices through variable movements in three-dimensional space; c. Incorporates three or more closed-loop or open-loop servodevices, which may include stepping motors;

text.zh:
d．通过教学、复演法或通过采用可编程序逻辑控制的电子计算机使该机有“用户可存取编程能力”，即无需机械干预。在上述定义中，“传感器”是指物理现象的探测器，其输出（在转换成一种可由控制器解释的信号之后）能够产生“程序”，或对“程序”指令或数字“程序”数据进行修改。其包括具有机器显示、红外线成像、声像、触觉测量、惯性位置测量、光学或声学测距或力测量或转矩测量等能力的“传感器”。在上述定义中，“用户可存取编程能力”是指允许用户采用以下方法之外的方法插入、修改或替换“程序”的设施：
a．布线或互接上的实际变化；
b．包括输入参数在内的功能控制器的设定。在上述定义中，“机器人”不包括以下装置：
a．仅采用手动控制、遥控的操纵机构；
b．固定顺序操纵机构，它们是按照机械式固定的程序运动的自动运转装置。通过固定的止动件（例如：销或凸轮）机械地限制该“程序”。采用机械的、电子的或电气的手段不可能改变或变更运转顺序和选择轨径或角度；
text.en: d. Has “user-accessible programmability” through teach/playback or an electronic computer with programmable logic control, without mechanical intervention. In this definition, “sensors” means detectors of physical phenomena whose output, after conversion into a signal interpretable by a controller, can generate “programs” or modify “program” instructions or numerical “program” data. These include “sensors” with capabilities for machine vision, infrared imaging, acoustic imaging, tactile measurement, inertial position measurement, optical or acoustic ranging, or force or torque measurement. In this definition, “user-accessible programmability” means facilities allowing users to insert, modify, or replace “programs” by means other than: a. Physical changes to wiring or interconnections; b. Setting function controls, including entering parameters. In this definition, “robots” do not include the following devices: a. Manipulation mechanisms controlled exclusively manually or by remote manual control; b. Fixed-sequence manipulation mechanisms: automatically operating devices that move according to mechanically fixed programs. The “program” is mechanically limited by fixed stops, such as pins or cams. The sequence of operations and choice of paths or angles cannot be changed by mechanical, electronic, or electrical means;

text.zh:
c．机械式控制可变顺序操纵机构，它们是按照机械式固定的程序运动的自动运转装置。通过固定的、然而却是可调的止动件（例如：销或凸轮）机械地限制该“程序”。在固定的“程序”模式里，运转顺序和轨径或角度的选择是可以改变的。只有通过机械操作才能改变或修改（例如：更改所用销或调换凸轮）一个或多个运动轴上“程序”模式；
d．非伺服控制可变顺序操纵机构，它们是按照机械式固定程序运动的自动运转装置。该“程序”是可以改变的，但是只有通过机械式固定的二进制电气装置输出的二进制信号或可调的止动件才能使运动按顺序继续进行；
e．被定义为笛卡尔坐标操纵系统的塔式起重机，作为垂直排列贮存箱仓库的组成部分，用于存取箱中的内装物。
2．在2B207 项中，“末端操纵装置”包括夹持器、“有源加工单元”以及附在“机器人”操纵臂末端主夹板上的任何其他工具。在上述定义中，“有源加工单元”是指一种对工件施加动力源、过程能量或对其进行检测的装置。
text.en: c. Mechanically controlled variable-sequence manipulation mechanisms: automatically operating devices that move according to mechanically fixed programs. The “program” is mechanically limited by fixed but adjustable stops, such as pins or cams. The sequence of operations and choice of paths or angles can be varied within a fixed “program” pattern. The “program” pattern for one or more motion axes can be changed or modified only through mechanical operations, such as changing pins or exchanging cams; d. Non-servo-controlled variable-sequence manipulation mechanisms: automatically operating devices that move according to mechanically fixed programs. The “program” can be changed, but the sequence proceeds only through binary signals output by mechanically fixed binary electrical devices or adjustable stops; e. Stacker cranes defined as Cartesian-coordinate manipulation systems, incorporated into warehouses with vertically arranged storage bins for accessing bin contents. 2. In 2B207, “end-effectors” include grippers, “active tooling units,” and any other tools attached to the baseplate at the end of a “robot” manipulator arm. In this definition, an “active tooling unit” means a device that applies motive power or process energy to, or senses, a workpiece.

title.zh: 振动试验系统、设备、部件：
title.en: Vibration test systems, equipment, and components:

summary.zh: 振动试验系统、设备、部件：
summary.en: Vibration test systems, equipment, and components:

text.zh:
2B210 振动试验系统、设备、部件：
a．具有以下所有特性的电动式振动试验系统：
1．使用反馈或闭环控制技术并包括“数控”单元；
2．能够在20～2000 Hz 频率范围内产生10 g₀ 均方根（RMS）或更大的振动；
3．能够施加50 kN 或更大的力（“空台”测量）；
b．数字控制器，装有为振动试验（实时频宽大于5 kHz）设计的软件，该软件也是为2B210.a 项所管制的系统设计的；
c．装有或未装有辅助放大器，能够施力50 kN 或更大（“空台”测量），可用于2B210.a 项管制的系统的振动启动器（振动装置）；
d．设计用来将多台振动装置联接成一完整振动系统以便能够提供50 kN 或更大的有效合力（“空台”测量），可用于2B210.a 项所管制的系统的试验部件支承结构和电子学装置；
e．为2B210.a 项专门设计的其他辅助设备。
技术说明：“空台”是指没有夹具及配件的平台或表面。
text.en: 2B210 Vibration test systems, equipment, and components: a. Electrodynamic vibration test systems having all of the following characteristics: 1. Using feedback or closed-loop control and incorporating a “numerical control” unit; 2. Capable of producing vibration of 10 g₀ root mean square (RMS) or greater over the frequency range of 20–2000 Hz; 3. Capable of applying a force of 50 kN or greater, measured with a “bare table”; b. Digital controllers incorporating software designed for vibration testing with a real-time bandwidth greater than 5 kHz, where that software is also designed for systems controlled under 2B210.a; c. Vibration exciters (shakers), with or without associated amplifiers, capable of applying 50 kN or greater, measured with a “bare table,” and usable in systems controlled under 2B210.a; d. Test-piece support structures and electronic units designed to combine multiple shakers into a complete vibration system capable of providing an effective combined force of 50 kN or greater, measured with a “bare table,” and usable in systems controlled under 2B210.a; e. Other ancillary equipment specially designed for 2B210.a. Technical Note: “Bare table” means a platform or surface without fixtures or fittings.

summary.zh: 固定式或便携式、卧式或立式离心多面平衡机：
summary.en: Centrifugal multiplane balancing machines, fixed or portable, horizontal or vertical:

text.zh:
2B219 固定式或便携式、卧式或立式离心多面平衡机：
a．设计用于平衡不短于600 mm 的柔性转子并具有以下所有特性的离心平衡机：
1．回转或轴颈直径大于等于75 mm；
2．质量容量0.9～23 kg；
3．平衡的旋转速度能够超过5000 rpm；
b．设计用于平衡空心圆柱形转子部件并具有以下所有特性的离心平衡机：
1．轴颈直径大于75 mm；
2．质量容量0.9～23 kg；
3．最小可实现剩余不平衡度小于等于每个平面10 g mm/kg；
4．皮带传动型。
text.en: 2B219 Centrifugal multiplane balancing machines, fixed or portable, horizontal or vertical: a. Centrifugal balancing machines designed for balancing flexible rotors 600 mm or longer and having all of the following characteristics: 1. A swing or journal diameter of 75 mm or greater; 2. A mass capacity of 0.9–23 kg; 3. Capable of balancing at rotational speeds exceeding 5000 rpm; b. Centrifugal balancing machines designed for balancing hollow cylindrical rotor components and having all of the following characteristics: 1. A journal diameter greater than 75 mm; 2. A mass capacity of 0.9–23 kg; 3. A minimum achievable residual specific unbalance of 10 g mm/kg or less per plane; 4. Belt-driven.

title.en: Remote manipulators for remote operations in radiochemical separation activities or hot cells, having either of the following characteristics:

summary.zh: 具有以下任一特性，用于为放射化学分离作业或热室提供远距离操作的遥控机械手：
summary.en: Remote manipulators for remote operations in radiochemical separation activities or hot cells, having either of the following characteristics:

text.zh:
2B225 具有以下任一特性，用于为放射化学分离作业或热室提供远距离操作的遥控机械手：
a．能够贯穿壁厚大于等于0.6 m 的热室壁（穿壁作业）；
b．能够跨过壁厚大于等于0.6 m 的热室顶（跨顶作业）。
技术说明：遥控机械手把操作员的动作转递给远距离操作臂和末端夹具。机械手可为“主、仆”型机械手，或者为通过控制杆或键盘操作的机械手。
text.en: 2B225 Remote manipulators for remote operations in radiochemical separation activities or hot cells, having either of the following characteristics: a. Capable of penetrating a hot-cell wall 0.6 m or more thick (through-wall operation); b. Capable of bridging over the top of a hot cell with a wall thickness of 0.6 m or greater (over-the-wall operation). Technical Note: Remote manipulators transmit an operator's actions to a remote operating arm and terminal fixture. Manipulators may be of the master-slave type, or operated by a joystick or keypad.

Power supplies specially designed for induction furnaces controlled under 2B226.a, with a rated output power of 5 kW or greater.

summary.zh: 真空炉或其他受控气氛冶金熔铸炉及相关设备：
summary.en: Vacuum or other controlled-atmosphere metallurgical melting and casting furnaces and related equipment:

text.zh:
2B227 真空炉或其他受控气氛冶金熔铸炉及相关设备：
a．具有以下两种特性的电弧重熔炉、电弧熔炉和电弧熔铸炉：
1．使用容量1000～20000 cm³ 的自耗电极；
2．能够在高于1700 ℃的熔化温度下工作；
b．具有以下两种特性的电子束熔化炉、等离子体雾化炉和等离子体熔化炉：
1．功率大于等于50 kW；
2．能够在高于1200 ℃的熔化温度下工作；
c．为2B227.a 或2B227.b 项所管制的任何炉专门配备的计算机控制系统和监测系统；
d．具有以下两种特性，为2B227.b 项所管制的炉专门设计的等离子体炬：
1．运行功率大于50 kW；
2．能够在高于1200 ℃的温度下工作；
e．为2B227.b 项所管制的炉专门设计，运行功率大于50 kW 的电子束枪。
text.en: 2B227 Vacuum or other controlled-atmosphere metallurgical melting and casting furnaces and related equipment: a. Arc-remelting, arc-melting, and arc-melting-and-casting furnaces having both of the following characteristics: 1. Using consumable electrodes with a capacity of 1000–20000 cm³; 2. Capable of operating at melting temperatures above 1700 °C; b. Electron-beam melting, plasma-atomization, and plasma-melting furnaces having both of the following characteristics: 1. A power of 50 kW or greater; 2. Capable of operating at melting temperatures above 1200 °C; c. Computer control and monitoring systems specially configured for any furnace controlled under 2B227.a or 2B227.b; d. Plasma torches specially designed for furnaces controlled under 2B227.b and having both of the following characteristics: 1. Operating power greater than 50 kW; 2. Capable of operating at temperatures above 1200 °C; e. Electron-beam guns specially designed for furnaces controlled under 2B227.b, with an operating power greater than 50 kW.

技术说明：2B228.b 项所管制的设备通常由连接计算机的精密测量探头组成，计算机随后控制诸如用于对准转子管件的气动活塞的动作。
c．生产单曲面波纹管用的波纹管成型芯轴和模具。
技术说明：2B228.c 项所管制的波纹管具有以下所有特性：
1．内径75～400 mm；
2．长度大于等于12.7 mm；
3．单曲面深度超过2 mm；
4．由高强度铝合金、马氏体时效钢或高强度纤维材料制造。
text.en: 2B228 Rotor manufacturing or assembly equipment, rotor-straightening equipment, and bellows-forming mandrels and dies: a. Rotor assembly equipment for assembling gas-centrifuge rotor tubes, baffles, and end caps; Note: 2B228.a controls precision mandrels, clamps and shrink-fit machines. b. Rotor-straightening equipment for aligning gas-centrifuge rotor tubes to a common axis; Technical Note: Equipment controlled by 2B228.b normally consists of precision measuring probes linked to a computer, which then controls actions such as those of pneumatic pistons used to align rotor tube sections. c. Bellows-forming mandrels and dies for producing single-convolution bellows. Technical Note: Bellows controlled under 2B228.c have all of the following characteristics: 1. An inside diameter of 75–400 mm; 2. A length of 12.7 mm or greater; 3. A single-convolution depth exceeding 2 mm; 4. Made of high-strength aluminum alloys, maraging steel, or high-strength fibrous materials.

text.zh:
2B230 具有以下所有特性的所有类型的压力传感器：
a．由铝、铝合金、氧化铝（矾土或蓝宝石）、镍、镍含量大于等于60%（按重量计）的镍合金或完全氟化的烃聚合物制造或保护的压力敏感元件；
b．如果有，压力敏感元件所需且直接接触过程介质的封装，该封装由铝、铝合金、氧化铝（矾土或蓝宝石）、镍、镍含量大于等于60%（按重量计）的镍合金、完全氟化的烃聚合物制造或保护；
c．具有以下任一特性：
1．满量程小于13 kPa、“精度”高于满量程±1%；
2．满量程大于等于13 kPa、13 kPa 压力点测量“精度”高于±130 Pa。
技术说明：
1．2B230 项所管制的压力传感器是把压力测量结果转变为电可用信号的装置。
2．2B230 项所述“精度”包括常温下非线性度、滞后量和再现性。
text.en: 2B230 Pressure transducers of all types having all of the following characteristics: a. Pressure-sensing elements made of or protected by aluminum, aluminum alloys, aluminum oxide (alumina or sapphire), nickel, nickel alloys containing 60% or more nickel by weight, or fully fluorinated hydrocarbon polymers; b. Any enclosures required for the pressure-sensing elements that directly contact the process medium are made of or protected by aluminum, aluminum alloys, aluminum oxide (alumina or sapphire), nickel, nickel alloys containing 60% or more nickel by weight, or fully fluorinated hydrocarbon polymers; c. Having either of the following characteristics: 1. A full scale of less than 13 kPa and “accuracy” better than ±1% of full scale; 2. A full scale of 13 kPa or greater and measurement “accuracy” better than ±130 Pa at 13 kPa. Technical Notes: 1. Pressure transducers controlled under 2B230 are devices that convert pressure measurements into electrically usable signals. 2. “Accuracy” in 2B230 includes nonlinearity, hysteresis, and repeatability at ambient temperature.

text.en: 2B231 Vacuum pumps having all of the following characteristics: a. An inlet throat diameter of 380 mm or greater; b. A pumping speed of 15 m³/s or greater; c. Capable of producing an ultimate vacuum below 13.3 mPa. Technical Notes: 1. Pumping speed is determined with nitrogen or air at the measurement point. 2. The ultimate vacuum can be measured at the pump inlet with the inlet blocked.
